first_principles_claim: Electricity is a chain of generation, transmission, distribution, interconnection, construction, financing, regulation, billing, and recovery; growth breaks when any link is missing.
main_subthemes: load versus deliverable power; data-center site constraint; regulatory recovery; contractor and equipment chokepoints; customer billing
money_path: customer demand -> utility/developer -> capex -> contractor/equipment spend -> recovery or contract revenue -> customer bills -> cash flow
safe_claim: Power scarcity is a growth gate because electricity must be delivered and recovered before demand becomes usable capacity.
proof_boundary: Load forecasts, capex plans, tariffs, and backlog do not prove receipts or returns.

first_principles_claim: Money changes meaning as it moves through products, wrappers, instruments, borrowers, assets, and legal entities.
main_subthemes: AUM boundary; insurance liabilities as credit demand; private-credit routing; legal-entity proof; origination and servicing control
money_path: saver/policyholder/institution -> platform -> fund/insurer -> instrument -> borrower/project/asset -> income/proceeds/repayment -> waterfall -> return
safe_claim: Capital platforms increasingly control routes through which money reaches private assets, credit, infrastructure, real estate, insurance portfolios, and borrowers.
proof_boundary: AUM, inflows, deployment, investment income, and fair value do not prove exact deployment or return.
article_use: Standalone essay seed and cash-proof bridge

first_principles_claim: Physical work is fragile because many inputs must be available at the same time; companies get paid when they reduce stoppages.
main_subthemes: equipment rental; MRO distribution; embedded inventory; electrical/HVAC supply; project execution
money_path: customer work need -> distributor/rental/contractor -> inventory/fleet/labor -> uptime -> revenue -> working-capital conversion -> cash flow
safe_claim: Industrial uptime is valuable because downtime is expensive and physical work has many failure points.
proof_boundary: Revenue, fleet, branch count, backlog, and margin do not prove fleet return, retainage, collateral quality, or project profit.

first_principles_claim: Medical need becomes economic value only after it passes through access, authorization, staffing, site capacity, pharmacy routing, billing, reimbursement, and trust.
main_subthemes: payers/PBMs; care delivery; home and alternate-site care; recurring care; trust
money_path: patient/employer/government need -> payer/provider/pharmacy/service -> authorized care -> delivered service -> claim/reimbursement -> cash collection
safe_claim: Healthcare companies are paid to organize access when patients, employers, governments, providers, and families cannot coordinate care alone.
proof_boundary: Volume, admissions, scripts, and revenue do not prove quality, fairness, trust, reimbursement quality, or cash realization.

first_principles_claim: Shelter and infrastructure are maintenance systems that keep demanding labor, materials, financing, distribution, and repair.
main_subthemes: repair over moving; Pro channels; waterworks and civic systems; coatings/lumber/HVAC; project cash conversion
money_path: repair need -> retailer/distributor/contractor/supplier -> material and labor delivery -> completed upkeep -> payment -> cash conversion
safe_claim: The built environment creates recurring upkeep demand because physical assets wear out even when new construction slows.
proof_boundary: Sales and project demand do not prove return; different channels have different cash economics.

first_principles_claim: The more activity moves online, the more valuable it becomes to control permission, identity, security, routing, data movement, and participation.
main_subthemes: security as permission; network routing; identity; workflow; digital worlds
money_path: digital activity -> control platform -> security/routing/workflow/identity service -> revenue -> retention/expansion -> operating cash
safe_claim: Digital-control companies sell the ability to make online activity safer, faster, more governed, and more usable.
proof_boundary: ARR, RPO, traffic, bookings, users, AI exposure, and large contracts do not prove durable cash conversion.

first_principles_claim: When money feels tight, people do not only seek low price; they seek lower regret.
main_subthemes: membership value; one-stop retail; dollar access; off-price status; closeout discovery
money_path: budget pressure -> retail format -> basket/trip behavior -> gross margin/inventory turn -> vendor/ad/membership economics -> cash conversion
safe_claim: Value retail matters because households seek formats that reduce regret about price, time, quality, status, and waste.
proof_boundary: Traffic, comps, ticket, membership, stores, ads, and margin do not prove durable loyalty or cash quality.

first_principles_claim: People buy services to change the state of their day: less effort, more time, more status, more relief, more connection, more novelty, or less friction.
main_subthemes: restaurants; travel; lodging; entertainment/casinos; advertising and attention
money_path: time/emotion/social need -> service provider/platform/location -> experience/convenience -> payment/ad spend -> occupancy/traffic/take-rate -> cash flow
safe_claim: Services reveal how people buy time, relief, experience, status, convenience, and attention under constraint.
proof_boundary: Service revenue does not prove consumer health and can coexist with debt stress, promotion pressure, wage inflation, and margin strain.

first_principles_claim: A household is not only a budget; it is a set of routines and identities that people defend even when they cut elsewhere.
main_subthemes: beauty/control; food habits; cleaning/order; apparel/status; packaging infrastructure
money_path: routine/identity need -> brand/category choice -> channel purchase -> volume/price/mix -> margin -> advertising/distribution -> cash conversion
safe_claim: Consumer goods matter because households cut, switch, delay, and trade down while defending manageable routines.
proof_boundary: Sales do not prove brand durability under price, income, channel, substitute, quality, and promotion pressure.

first_principles_claim: Every clean growth story eventually meets a physical denominator: inputs must be mined, processed, permitted, moved, financed, and delivered.
main_subthemes: grid/data-center inputs; housing/repair inputs; food productivity; manufacturing/infrastructure; cost curves
money_path: end-market buildout -> input demand -> producer/distributor capacity -> material sale -> working capital/transport -> margin -> cash flow
safe_claim: Basic materials are the hidden denominator beneath power, housing, food, infrastructure, manufacturing, and energy buildout.
proof_boundary: End-market demand does not prove pricing power or return; cost curve and capital intensity matter.

first_principles_claim: A place becomes valuable when a needed activity cannot easily move and the tenant or user can keep paying through the debt cycle.
main_subthemes: towers; data centers; logistics; healthcare real estate; hotels and retail
money_path: tenant/user location need -> property owner/developer -> lease/occupancy -> rent/fee collection -> operating cost/capex -> debt service -> cash return
safe_claim: Modern real estate value comes from scarce usable locations, not generic square footage.
proof_boundary: Ownership does not prove pricing power; occupancy, renewal, tenant quality, debt maturity, capex, and collections matter.

first_principles_claim: Digital life feels weightless only because a heavy stack of physical and logical infrastructure keeps it working.
main_subthemes: semiconductors; networking/telecom; storage; enterprise software; hardware/equipment
money_path: workload/digital need -> hardware/software/network stack -> product/service -> revenue -> infrastructure/support cost -> cash conversion
safe_claim: The broader technology story is the full stack that lets digital activity compute, move, store, secure, and organize itself.
proof_boundary: AI exposure, orders, backlog, ARR, RPO, traffic, and users do not prove durable value without unit economics and cash conversion.

first_principles_claim: Healthcare access is physical and administrative infrastructure before it is a medical outcome.
main_subthemes: devices; diagnostics/labs; drug distribution/pharmacies; hospitals; medical suppliers
money_path: medical need -> device/lab/distributor/provider/supplier -> product/service -> payment -> reimbursement/working capital -> cash realization
safe_claim: Care cannot be delivered without devices, diagnostics, supplies, distribution, sites, labor, compliance, and billing systems.
proof_boundary: Procedures, tests, admissions, and product sales do not prove outcomes, access, fair pricing, or cash quality.

first_principles_claim: Energy affects everything because molecules and electrons must move through physical, contractual, financial, and regulatory systems before use.
main_subthemes: upstream depletion; refining; midstream routing; LNG/NGL export; energy cost pass-through
money_path: energy demand -> producer/refiner/midstream/service -> production/processing/transport/storage -> sale/contract -> margin -> debt service/cash return
safe_claim: Energy affordability is a whole-economy issue because fuel, power, transport, heating, food, manufacturing, and digital infrastructure depend on usable energy routes.
proof_boundary: Volume, commodity price, tariffs, and refining margins do not prove durable cash return.

first_principles_claim: Financial pressure becomes real when it changes the promises households and businesses can make, keep, refinance, insure, or delay.
main_subthemes: card balances; deposits/rates; insurance; payments; credit availability
money_path: financial need -> bank/card/insurer/payment/broker -> loan/deposit/premium/fee/transaction -> spread/fee/claims/loss -> cash/capital outcome
safe_claim: Ordinary finance shows how pressure reaches people and businesses through credit, deposits, premiums, payments, losses, rates, and refinancing.
proof_boundary: Scale in finance does not prove customer health, credit quality, productive money use, or durable spread.
